text: 皮细胞上。由于临床使用的大多数药物都是P-gp底物和或调节剂，容易引起相应的药物相互作用。本文重点介绍了P-gp与血脑屏障、P-gp对中枢神经系统(CNS)药物作用的研究进展、P-gp介导的相互作用及在中枢神经系统上产生的药物效应或副作用。(中南大学湘雅二医院临床药学研究室, 长沙 410011)SHEN Yuan, LI Huan - de(Clinical Pharmacy Research Institute, The Xiangya Second Hospital, Centra South University, Changsha 410011, China)Abstract: P - glycoprotein (P - gp) which belongs the ATP binding cassette transporter superfamily is one of the major transporters investigated. It is widespread on humans' lumina epithelial cells of intestines, lungs, kidneys and brain capillaries endothelium cells. As a great many drugs are substrates or modulators of P - gp, drug - drug interactions might be involved in clinical therapy. The review addressed P - gp and blood brain barrier;the research progress concerning role of P - gp played on central nervous system drugs;
